correctness.rationale: Conditioning F_k=1 deletes a singleton Ewens cycle and leaves an Ewens(theta) permutation of size n-1. This proves the complete local covariance tensor via E[Y_ab|F_k=1] and the known pair-inversion probability. For nonincident k outside [a,b], the exact numerator is theta(1-theta)(2(b-a)+theta-2); for inside, theta(1-theta)(2(b-a)-n-1), with common positive denominator (n+theta-1)^2(n+theta-2)(n+theta-3). Incident conditional probabilities are (a-1)/(n+theta-2) and (n-b)/(n+theta-2). Independent rational Ewens-weight enumeration checked every local triple for n=3..6 at theta=1/2,1,2. The total inversion covariance profile is separately obtained by summation and has exact parabolic sign geometry, but that parabolic formula is prior known.

originality.rationale: The October 26 published Resultary centered-parabola theorem already establishes the entire position-indexed covariance with total inversions, its positive sqrt(n) window and macroscopic scaling. Those are explicitly not new here. The surviving distinct result is the FULL designated fixed-position versus individual inversion-pair covariance tensor including inside/outside gap sign transition and incident cases; the earlier theorem supplies only its sum, which does not determine individual entries. Pinsky–Schickentanz gives unconditional pair-inversion marginals and fixed-point COUNT conditioning, but not this local two-index/three-index mixed tensor. Best-of-knowledge risk: algebra is accessible via a standard Ewens deletion identity.
